evidence.reason: When `_show_scope` returns `LoadState == "not-found"`, the ownership/membership check is skipped, but the code still unconditionally runs `systemctl --user stop` on the run-ID-derived scope. A second state directory with the same run ID can create that scope between the show and the stop, so cleanup can stop a scope this run does not own. This is a TOCTOU defect in the existing ownership verification, not a request for a new requirement; skip the stop when the scope is absent or re-verify ownership immediately before stopping.
